vo.text: A small set of profiles, one per condition, is easier to run a season with than a long list of dated snapshots.
vo.next_text: Plan what goes in the five slots. The tab lists five named profile slots for each Lynx course.

vo.text: Plan what goes in the five slots. The tab lists five named profile slots for each Lynx course.
vo.previous_text: A small set of profiles, one per condition, is easier to run a season with than a long list of dated snapshots.
vo.next_text: A short list stays readable a year later. Applying a profile is a course-wide recalculation, so treat it as a planned change rather than a quick switch.

vo.text: A short list stays readable a year later. Applying a profile is a course-wide recalculation, so treat it as a planned change rather than a quick switch.
vo.previous_text: Plan what goes in the five slots. The tab lists five named profile slots for each Lynx course.
vo.next_text: Applying rewrites the target of every station in the profile and recalculates their suggestions; stations not in the profile keep their targets.

vo.text: Applying rewrites the target of every station in the profile and recalculates their suggestions; stations not in the profile keep their targets.
vo.previous_text: A short list stays readable a year later. Applying a profile is a course-wide recalculation, so treat it as a planned change rather than a quick switch.
vo.next_text: Doing it the evening before leaves you the next morning to read the new suggestions against a fresh scan. Apply, then review the next morning’s suggestions.

vo.text: Doing it the evening before leaves you the next morning to read the new suggestions against a fresh scan. Apply, then review the next morning’s suggestions.
vo.previous_text: Applying rewrites the target of every station in the profile and recalculates their suggestions; stations not in the profile keep their targets.
vo.next_text: A profile changes targets, and targets change deficits. Scan the Suggested column for stations that jumped to the cap — those are the ones where the new target is a long way from where the station actually is.

vo.next_text: The push dialog is the same as any other day. The difference is the size of the change set: a profile switch usually queues most of the course at once.
